name: La Belle Vie
signature_dish: Crème brûlée with a 180-degree view over the tea gardens
why_it_matters: Coonoor's signature view restaurant — set in the McIver 180 Villa in Bedford with a 180-degree sweep over the tea gardens and Coonoor town. The Bollywood film Kapoor & Sons was shot here. French-inspired Indian-Continental cooking; the crème brûlée and the view are why it stays on every Coonoor list.
insider_tip: Go for a late-afternoon table to catch the tea-garden light before the mist closes in. Desserts — especially the crème brûlée — are the kitchen's strength; book ahead on weekends.
signature_address: La Belle Vie, McIver 180 Villa, Bedford, Coonoor, Tamil Nadu 643101

name: Cherrie Berry — Farm to Table
signature_dish: Vegetarian farm-to-table plates in a converted tea factory
why_it_matters: A 'Wholesome Foods & Farm to Table' vegetarian restaurant in a modified tea factory on the Highfield Estate near Sim's Park — most produce comes from its own farms. Combines fine dining, a cafe, an organic supermarket and a kids' soft-play area, which makes it Coonoor's default family destination.
insider_tip: It's a full destination, not just a meal — the organic store sells estate produce and homemade cheese, and there's ample parking and a kids' play zone. The high-ceilinged tea-factory room is the nicest place to sit.
signature_address: Cherrie Berry, Highfield Estate, near Sim's Park, Coonoor, Tamil Nadu 643101

name: Open Kitchen
why_it_matters: A tiny cafe down a narrow lane in Bedford that several reviewers call the best pizza they've had in India — thin whole-wheat crust, wood-fired, with sundried tomatoes and locally sourced cheese. Small, popular and consistently top-ranked among Coonoor restaurants.
insider_tip: It's hard to find — a narrow lane off Club Road in Bedford, just 27 Simrath Villa. The room is small, so come early or expect a short wait. Whole-wheat thin-crust pizza is the order.
signature_address: Open Kitchen, 27 Simrath Villa, Club Road, Bedford, Coonoor, Tamil Nadu 643101

name: Hyderabad Biryani House Coonoor
why_it_matters: Coonoor's reliable biryani address — a casual Hyderabadi-style dum biryani house in Bedford that the town turns to for an affordable non-veg meal. Listed among Coonoor's top restaurants on Tripadvisor.
insider_tip: Lunch is the freshest biryani service. Quick and pocket-friendly — a solid stop between Sim's Park and the Bedford cafes rather than a destination meal.
signature_address: Hyderabad Biryani House, Bedford, Coonoor, Tamil Nadu 643101

name: Sri Lakshmi Cafe
signature_dish: South Indian breakfast tiffin with filter coffee
why_it_matters: A no-frills South Indian cafe in the Coonoor town centre — the everyday tiffin-and-filter-coffee address for locals, with strong word-of-mouth for breakfast. The honest, cheap counterpoint to Coonoor's view cafes.
insider_tip: Come for breakfast — idli, dosa and filter coffee are what it does best, and the morning batch is freshest. Pure-veg, fast turnover, cash-friendly.
signature_address: Sri Lakshmi Cafe, Coonoor town centre, Coonoor, Tamil Nadu 643101

name: The Chaiwala
signature_dish: Gujarati and North Indian vegetarian plates with masala chai
why_it_matters: A small family-run vegetarian spot serving Gujarati and Maharashtrian-North Indian food — a rarity in the Nilgiris — run by Dileep, Ekta, Nishant and Bhavna in a homely room. The veg chaat and warm feel make it a budget favourite on Coonoor lists.
insider_tip: This is the place for chaat and a proper Gujarati thali in a hill station that otherwise leans Tamil. Pure-veg, homely and inexpensive — good for an evening snack.
signature_address: The Chaiwala, Coonoor town, Coonoor, Tamil Nadu 643101
